import Mathlib

structure BFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BFSGraph.well_formed (g : BFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.size (g : BFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.has_edge (g : BFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BFSGraph.is_path (g : BFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def BFSGraph.reachable (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

def BFSGraph.is_shortest_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ p.length = d + 1) ∧
  (∀ p, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → p.length ≥ d + 1)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_precond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.size ≤ 10000 ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Out-neighbours of a node, as a list. -/
def BFSGraph.nbrs (g : BFSGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

/-- `PathFrom g a q` : `a :: q` is a walk in `g`. -/
def PathFrom (g : BFSGraph) : Nat → List Nat → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | a, b :: q => g.has_edge a b ∧ PathFrom g b q

/-- `ReachIn g s k v` : `v` is reachable from `s` using exactly `k` edges. -/
inductive ReachIn (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Prop
  | base : ReachIn g s 0 s
  | step {k u v : Nat} : ReachIn g s k u → g.has_edge u v → ReachIn g s (k + 1) v

/-- One BFS level expansion: the unvisited out-neighbours of the current frontier. -/
def bfsNext (g : BFSGraph) (visited frontier : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((frontier.flatMap g.nbrs).filter (fun v => decide (v ∉ visited))).dedup

/-- Level-synchronous BFS loop.  `frontier` holds the nodes at distance `d`,
`visited` the nodes at distance `≤ d`. -/
def bfsLoop (g : BFSGraph) (target : Nat) :
    Nat → List Nat → List Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, _, _, _ => none
  | fuel + 1, visited, frontier, d =>
      if frontier = [] then none
      else if target ∈ frontier then some d
      else
        bfsLoop g target fuel (visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier)
          (bfsNext g visited frontier) (d + 1)

/-- Specification of the loop's result in terms of `ReachIn`. -/
def BFSSpec (g : BFSGraph) (s target : Nat) : Option Nat → Prop
  | some r => ReachIn g s r target ∧ ∀ j, j < r → ¬ ReachIn g s j target
  | none => ∀ k, ¬ ReachIn g s k target

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bfs_shortest_path (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bfsLoop graph target (graph.size + 1) [start] [start] 0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_postcond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dist => graph.is_shortest_distance start target dist
  | none => ¬ graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem getD_eq_getElem_aux (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) :
    l.getD i 0 = l[i] := by
  simp [List.getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h]

theorem getD_cons_succ' (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0 = l.getD i 0 := by
  simp [List.getD]

theorem getD_cons_zero' (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  simp [List.getD]

theorem is_path_singleton (g : BFSGraph) (a : Nat) : g.is_path [a] := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  simp at hi

theorem is_path_cons_cons (g : BFSGraph) (a b : Nat) (q : List Nat) :
    g.is_path (a :: b :: q) ↔ g.has_edge a b ∧ g.is_path (b :: q) := by
  unfold BFSGraph.is_path
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := h
    refine ⟨?_, by simp, ?_⟩
    · have := h2 0 (by simp)
      rwa [getD_cons_zero', getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_zero'] at this
    · intro i hi
      have hlt : i + 1 + 1 < (a :: b :: q).length := by simp at hi ⊢; omega
      have := h2 (i + 1) hlt
      rwa [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_succ'] at this
  · intro h
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero =>
        rw [getD_cons_zero', getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_zero']
        exact h.1
    | succ i =>
        rw [getD_cons_succ', getD_cons_succ']
        refine h.2.2 i ?_
        simp at hi ⊢
        omega

theorem is_path_iff_pathFrom (g : BFSGraph) :
    ∀ (q : List Nat) (a : Nat), g.is_path (a :: q) ↔ PathFrom g a q := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
      intro a
      simp only [PathFrom, iff_true]
      exact is_path_singleton g a
  | cons b q ih =>
      intro a
      rw [is_path_cons_cons, ih b]
      exact Iff.rfl

theorem getLast?_cons_append (v : Nat) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    (a :: (q ++ [v])).getLast? = some v := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons b q ih => intro a; simpa using ih b

theorem pathFrom_append (g : BFSGraph) (v : Nat) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (a u : Nat),
    PathFrom g a q → (a :: q).getLast? = some u → g.has_edge u v →
    PathFrom g a (q ++ [v]) := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
      intro a u _ hl he
      simp at hl
      subst hl
      exact ⟨he, trivial⟩
  | cons b q ih =>
      intro a u hp hl he
      have hl' : (b :: q).getLast? = some u := by simpa using hl
      exact ⟨hp.1, ih b u hp.2 hl' he⟩

theorem has_edge_iff_nbrs (g : BFSGraph) (u v : Nat) :
    g.has_edge u v ↔ v ∈ g.nbrs u := by
  unfold BFSGraph.has_edge BFSGraph.nbrs
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h.2
  · intro h
    have h2 : v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by simpa using h
    refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
    by_contra hc
    have he : g.adj.getD u #[] = #[] := by simp [Array.getD, hc]
    rw [he] at h2
    simp at h2

theorem ReachIn_succ_iff (g : BFSGraph) (s k v : Nat) :
    ReachIn g s (k + 1) v ↔ ∃ u, ReachIn g s k u ∧ g.has_edge u v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | step hr e => exact ⟨_, hr, e⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨u, hr, e⟩ := h
    exact ReachIn.step hr e

theorem ReachIn_zero_iff (g : BFSGraph) (s v : Nat) :
    ReachIn g s 0 v ↔ v = s := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h; rfl
  · intro h; subst h; exact ReachIn.base

theorem ReachIn.prepend (g : BFSGraph) (a b : Nat) (e : g.has_edge a b) :
    ∀ {m t : Nat}, ReachIn g b m t → ReachIn g a (m + 1) t := by
  intro m t h
  induction h with
  | base => exact ReachIn.step ReachIn.base e
  | step hr e' ih => exact ReachIn.step ih e'

theorem chain_reach (g : BFSGraph) : ∀ (q : List Nat) (a t : Nat),
    PathFrom g a q → (a :: q).getLast? = some t →
    ReachIn g a q.length t := by
  intro q
  induction q with
  | nil =>
      intro a t _ hl
      simp at hl
      subst hl
      simpa using ReachIn.base
  | cons b q ih =>
      intro a t hc hl
      have hl' : (b :: q).getLast? = some t := by
        simpa using hl
      have := ih b t hc.2 hl'
      simpa using ReachIn.prepend g a b hc.1 this

theorem path_to_reach (g : BFSGraph) (s t : Nat) (p : List Nat) (hp : g.is_path p)
    (hh : p.head? = some s) (hl : p.getLast? = some t) :
    ReachIn g s (p.length - 1) t := by
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd hp.1 (by simp)
  | cons a q =>
      simp at hh
      subst hh
      have hc := (is_path_iff_pathFrom g q a).1 hp
      simpa using chain_reach g q a t hc hl

theorem reach_chain (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) : ∀ {k v : Nat}, ReachIn g s k v →
    ∃ q : List Nat, PathFrom g s q ∧ q.length = k ∧
      (s :: q).getLast? = some v := by
  intro k v h
  induction h with
  | base => exact ⟨[], trivial, rfl, by simp⟩
  | @step k u v hr e ih =>
      obtain ⟨q, hc, hlen, hlast⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨q ++ [v], pathFrom_append g v q s u hc hlast e, by simp [hlen],
        getLast?_cons_append v q s⟩

theorem reach_to_path (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) {k v : Nat} (h : ReachIn g s k v) :
    ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some s ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ p.length = k + 1 := by
  obtain ⟨q, hc, hlen, hlast⟩ := reach_chain g s h
  exact ⟨s :: q, (is_path_iff_pathFrom g q s).2 hc, by simp, hlast, by simp [hlen]⟩

theorem mem_bfsNext (g : BFSGraph) (visited frontier : List Nat) (v : Nat) :
    v ∈ bfsNext g visited frontier ↔ (∃ u ∈ frontier, g.has_edge u v) ∧ v ∉ visited := by
  unfold bfsNext
  rw [List.mem_dedup, List.mem_filter]
  simp only [List.mem_flatMap, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨u, hu, hv⟩, hnv⟩ := h
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu, (has_edge_iff_nbrs g u v).2 hv⟩, hnv⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨u, hu, he⟩, hnv⟩ := h
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu, (has_edge_iff_nbrs g u v).1 he⟩, hnv⟩

theorem nodup_length_le (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h1 : l.Nodup)
    (h2 : ∀ v ∈ l, v < n) : l.length ≤ n := by
  classical
  have hsub : l.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact h2 x hx
  have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  rwa [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h1, Finset.card_range] at hc

theorem exhausted (g : BFSGraph) (s d : Nat)
    (hno : ∀ v, ReachIn g s d v → ∃ j, j < d ∧ ReachIn g s j v) :
    ∀ k v, ReachIn g s k v → ∃ j, j ≤ d ∧ ReachIn g s j v := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    by_cases hk : k ≤ d
    · exact ⟨k, hk, hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, e⟩ := (ReachIn_succ_iff g s m v).1 hv
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hju⟩ := ih m (by omega) u hu
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j d with hlt | hge
      · exact ⟨j + 1, by omega, ReachIn.step hju e⟩
      · have hjd : j = d := by omega
        subst hjd
        obtain ⟨j', hj', hj'u⟩ := hno u hju
        exact ⟨j' + 1, by omega, ReachIn.step hj'u e⟩

theorem target_unreachable (g : BFSGraph) (s target d : Nat)
    (hno : ∀ v, ReachIn g s d v → ∃ j, j < d ∧ ReachIn g s j v)
    (hT : ∀ j, j < d → ¬ ReachIn g s j target) :
    ∀ k, ¬ ReachIn g s k target := by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjt⟩ := exhausted g s d hno k target hk
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j d with h | h
  · exact hT j h hjt
  · have hjd : j = d := by omega
    subst hjd
    obtain ⟨j', hj', h'⟩ := hno target hjt
    exact hT j' hj' h'

theorem bfsLoop_correct (g : BFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (s target : Nat) :
    ∀ (fuel : Nat) (visited frontier : List Nat) (d : Nat),
      (∀ v, v ∈ visited ↔ ∃ k, k ≤ d ∧ ReachIn g s k v) →
      (∀ v, v ∈ frontier ↔ (ReachIn g s d v ∧ ∀ j, j < d → ¬ ReachIn g s j v)) →
      visited.Nodup →
      (∀ v ∈ visited, v < g.size) →
      (∀ j, j < d → ¬ ReachIn g s j target) →
      (g.size + 1 ≤ visited.length + fuel ∨ frontier = []) →
      BFSSpec g s target (bfsLoop g target fuel visited frontier d) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
      intro visited frontier d hV hF hN hB hT hFuel
      rw [bfsLoop]
      show ∀ k, ¬ ReachIn g s k target
      rcases hFuel with h | h
      · exfalso
        have := nodup_length_le visited g.size hN hB
        omega
      · refine target_unreachable g s target d ?_ hT
        intro v hv
        have : v ∉ frontier := by rw [h]; simp
        rw [hF v] at this
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact this ⟨hv, fun j hj => hcon j hj⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro visited frontier d hV hF hN hB hT hFuel
      rw [bfsLoop]
      by_cases hemp : frontier = []
      · rw [if_pos hemp]
        show ∀ k, ¬ ReachIn g s k target
        refine target_unreachable g s target d ?_ hT
        intro v hv
        have : v ∉ frontier := by rw [hemp]; simp
        rw [hF v] at this
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact this ⟨hv, fun j hj => hcon j hj⟩
      · rw [if_neg hemp]
        by_cases htf : target ∈ frontier
        · rw [if_pos htf]
          exact (hF target).1 htf
        · rw [if_neg htf]
          -- prepare the invariants for the next level
          have hnotd : ¬ ReachIn g s d target := by
            intro hc
            exact htf ((hF target).2 ⟨hc, hT⟩)
          have hT' : ∀ j, j < d + 1 → ¬ ReachIn g s j target := by
            intro j hj
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j d with h | h
            · exact hT j h
            · have : j = d := by omega
              subst this
              exact hnotd
          have hkey : ∀ v, v ∈ bfsNext g visited frontier ↔
              (ReachIn g s (d + 1) v ∧ ∀ j, j < d + 1 → ¬ ReachIn g s j v) := by
            intro v
            rw [mem_bfsNext]
            constructor
            · intro h
              obtain ⟨⟨u, hu, e⟩, hnv⟩ := h
              have hru : ReachIn g s d u := ((hF u).1 hu).1
              refine ⟨ReachIn.step hru e, ?_⟩
              intro j hj hrj
              exact hnv ((hV v).2 ⟨j, by omega, hrj⟩)
            · intro h
              obtain ⟨hr, hmin⟩ := h
              have hnv : v ∉ visited := by
                intro hc
                obtain ⟨k, hk, hrk⟩ := (hV v).1 hc
                exact hmin k (by omega) hrk
              obtain ⟨u, hu, e⟩ := (ReachIn_succ_iff g s d v).1 hr
              refine ⟨⟨u, ?_, e⟩, hnv⟩
              refine (hF u).2 ⟨hu, ?_⟩
              intro j hj hrj
              exact hmin (j + 1) (by omega) (ReachIn.step hrj e)
          have hV' : ∀ v, v ∈ visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier ↔
              ∃ k, k ≤ d + 1 ∧ ReachIn g s k v := by
            intro v
            rw [List.mem_append]
            constructor
            · intro h
              rcases h with h | h
              · obtain ⟨k, hk, hrk⟩ := (hV v).1 h
                exact ⟨k, by omega, hrk⟩
              · exact ⟨d + 1, le_refl _, ((hkey v).1 h).1⟩
            · intro h
              obtain ⟨k, hk, hrk⟩ := h
              by_cases hvv : v ∈ visited
              · exact Or.inl hvv
              · have hmin : ∀ j, j < d + 1 → ¬ ReachIn g s j v := by
                  intro j hj hrj
                  exact hvv ((hV v).2 ⟨j, by omega, hrj⟩)
                have hkd : k = d + 1 := by
                  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (d + 1) with h | h
                  · exact absurd hrk (hmin k h)
                  · omega
                subst hkd
                exact Or.inr ((hkey v).2 ⟨hrk, hmin⟩)
          have hN' : (visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier).Nodup := by
            rw [List.nodup_append]
            refine ⟨hN, List.nodup_dedup _, ?_⟩
            intro a ha b hb heq
            exact ((mem_bfsNext g visited frontier b).1 hb).2 (heq ▸ ha)
          have hB' : ∀ v ∈ visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier, v < g.size := by
            intro v hv
            rw [List.mem_append] at hv
            rcases hv with hv | hv
            · exact hB v hv
            · obtain ⟨⟨u, _, e⟩, _⟩ := (mem_bfsNext g visited frontier v).1 hv
              exact hwf u e.1 v e.2
          have hFuel' : g.size + 1 ≤ (visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier).length + fuel ∨
              bfsNext g visited frontier = [] := by
            by_cases hn : bfsNext g visited frontier = []
            · exact Or.inr hn
            · left
              have h1 : 0 < (bfsNext g visited frontier).length :=
                List.length_pos_of_ne_nil hn
              have h2 : g.size + 1 ≤ visited.length + (fuel + 1) := by
                rcases hFuel with h | h
                · exact h
                · exact absurd h hemp
              rw [List.length_append]
              omega
          exact ih (visited ++ bfsNext g visited frontier) (bfsNext g visited frontier) (d + 1)
            hV' hkey hN' hB' hT' hFuel'

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bfs_shortest_path_postcond_satisfied (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) :
    bfs_shortest_path_postcond graph start target
      (bfs_shortest_path graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hsz, hst, htg⟩ := h_precond
  have hspec := bfsLoop_correct graph hwf start target (graph.size + 1) [start] [start] 0
    (by
      intro v
      simp only [List.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨0, le_refl _, by rw [ReachIn_zero_iff]; exact h⟩
      · intro h
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hrk⟩ := h
        have : k = 0 := by omega
        subst this
        exact (ReachIn_zero_iff graph start v).1 hrk)
    (by
      intro v
      simp only [List.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨by rw [ReachIn_zero_iff]; exact h, by intro j hj; omega⟩
      · intro h
        exact (ReachIn_zero_iff graph start v).1 h.1)
    (by simp)
    (by intro v hv; simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hv; subst hv; exact hst)
    (by intro j hj; omega)
    (by left; simp)
  unfold bfs_shortest_path
  cases hres : bfsLoop graph target (graph.size + 1) [start] [start] 0 with
  | none =>
      rw [hres] at hspec
      show ¬ graph.reachable start target
      intro hr
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := hr
      exact hspec (p.length - 1) (path_to_reach graph start target p hp hh hl)
  | some r =>
      rw [hres] at hspec
      obtain ⟨hr, hmin⟩ := hspec
      show graph.is_shortest_distance start target r
      refine ⟨reach_to_path graph start hr, ?_⟩
      intro p hp hh hl
      have hrp := path_to_reach graph start target p hp hh hl
      have hlen : 0 < p.length := hp.1
      by_contra hcon
      have : p.length - 1 < r := by omega
      exact hmin (p.length - 1) this hrp
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**LEAN VERIFIED** — the only output is a benign unused-variable warning for the teacher-supplied `h_precond`.

What I implemented, all inside the four markers:

- **auxcode**: `BFSGraph.nbrs` (adjacency as a list), `PathFrom` (walk predicate), `ReachIn` (inductive "reachable in exactly k edges"), `bfsNext` (one level expansion: unvisited out-neighbours of the frontier, deduplicated), `bfsLoop` (level-synchronous BFS carrying `visited`, `frontier`, level `d`, and a fuel bound), and `BFSSpec` (the loop's result spec).
- **code**: `bfsLoop graph target (graph.size + 1) [start] [start] 0`.
- **lemma**: the bridge between the index-based `is_path`/`getLast?` spec and `ReachIn`, membership characterization of `bfsNext`, a pigeonhole bound (`Nodup` + values `< size` ⇒ `length ≤ size`), a frontier-exhaustion lemma, and the main loop invariant theorem.
- **proof**: instantiates the loop lemma at the initial state and converts `ReachIn`-minimality into `is_shortest_distance` / unreachability.

The loop invariant is the real BFS argument: `frontier` = nodes whose *minimal* distance is exactly `d`, `visited` = nodes at distance `≤ d`, plus "no level `< d` contained the target". Minimality of the returned distance falls straight out of the frontier invariant; `none` is justified either by an empty frontier (via the exhaustion lemma: nothing reachable beyond distance `d`) or by the fuel bound, where `visited` being duplicate-free and bounded by `graph.size` makes fuel exhaustion with a non-empty frontier impossible.
